limitations: Source screenshots do not cover live MathML/SVG/reference presentation.
Static screenshots cannot prove End/Home horizontal reachability; separate native interaction evidence is required.
Source mode intentionally preserves unwrapped lines: record visible horizontal overflow rather than claim every source line fully visible.
X11 captures include black root desktop outside the app window; that region is not editor clipping.
Scroll viewport boundaries may partially expose unrelated adjacent rows; target-marker and target source observations are distinguished.
